chapters.reason: The paper explicitly uses learnable pause tokens to delay next-token prediction, which is the definition of a single control mechanism for modulating reasoning dynamics.
The pause tokens effectively introduce iterative computation by allowing the model to process extra hidden vectors before committing to an output, functioning as a form of recurrent execution.
The approach manipulates the reasoning process by inserting non-interpretable latent tokens (pause tokens) into the sequence to steer the model's hidden state computation.
